title: Gaussian rotation sensitivity bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $A\subseteq\mathbb R^n$ be measurable. For every $\theta\in[0,\pi/2]$, $$2\bigl(\gamma_n(A)-H(\cos\theta,\gamma_n(A))\bigr)\le s_A(\theta),$$ where $\gamma_n$ is standard Gaussian measure, $s_A(\theta)$ is the probability that membership changes under $g\mapsto\cos(\theta)g+\sin(\theta)h$ for independent standard Gaussian vectors $g,h$, and $H(\rho,\alpha)$ is the Gaussian halfspace stability defined using threshold $\Phi^{-1}(\alpha)$ for $0<\alpha<1$, with values $0$ for $\alpha\le0$ and $1$ for $\alpha\ge1$.
